title: Project Gherkin
description: A Vanilla+ modpack focused on performance, immersive visuals, cinematic gameplay, and multiplayer-friendly quality of life enhancements while keeping the core Minecraft experience intact.
body:
# Project Gherkin

Project Gherkin is a lightweight Vanilla+ Minecraft modpack focused on performance, immersive visuals, smooth gameplay, and multiplayer-friendly quality-of-life improvements.

Designed for SMPs and long-term survival worlds, the modpack improves the overall Minecraft experience while still keeping the core vanilla feeling intact. The goal is to make Minecraft feel smoother, cleaner, and more immersive without heavily changing the game itself.

## Features

* Massive FPS and optimization improvements
* Lightweight and smooth gameplay experience
* Enhanced visuals and atmosphere
* Better animations and immersive effects
* Multiplayer-friendly setup
* Better UI and quality-of-life improvements
* Vanilla-friendly experience
* Fabric 1.21.11 support
* Iris shader support *(shaders not included)*

## Optimization

Project Gherkin includes multiple optimization-focused mods to improve FPS, chunk loading, rendering, memory usage, and overall game smoothness while keeping the pack lightweight and stable.

## Recommended

* 8GB RAM or higher
* Optional shader support through Iris
* Best experienced on SMP and survival servers

## Credits

Project Gherkin was inspired by the KwuarmPlayz Modpack, but this pack contains its own tweaks, settings, and overall experience.

Please do not expect the exact same visuals shown in KwuarmPlayz content, especially since shaders are not included in this release.

## Focus

This modpack is built for players who want Minecraft to feel smoother, more modern, and more immersive while still keeping the familiar vanilla survival experience.
